A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same readable 29-page ProLong study, including Appendices A–D. Extracted text and rendered pages match throughout, apart from the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v2 reports original ProLong training experiments, benchmark evaluations and ablations in Sections 3–6 and Appendix B, including the results in Tables 10–12.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original ProLong experiments, benchmark results and appendix ablations. Results retained from v2 remain original empirical results of this work.

M1.justification: The ProLong training recipe, initialization, data mixture, position extrapolation, document masking and supervised fine-tuning procedure are identical, including Table 9 and Appendix A.

E1.justification: Training data and task coverage are unchanged. Both versions retain HELMET, the five short-context benchmarks, NoCha, RULER, ∞Bench and the document-QA examples in Appendix D.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain identical comparator sets, including the models in Tables 10, 12 and 26 and the comparison with Fu et al. (2024) in Table 24.

E3.justification: Training budgets, sequence lengths, preprocessing, metrics and evaluation procedures are identical. This includes the 32K/64K ablation averaging, 128K main HELMET evaluation and 512K stress tests.

E4.justification: The data-mixture, training-length, SFT, RoPE, document-mask, initialization and stronger-generator ablations are unchanged. Appendix D also retains the same qualitative case studies.

E5.justification: Figure 2 reports the same means and standard deviations over two training runs in both versions. No repeated-run disclosures or uncertainty-reporting practices change elsewhere.

E6.justification: Numerical entries, plotted trends and qualitative findings are identical, including appendix results. For example, Table 10 retains 128K HELMET averages of 49.4 for ProLong and 46.5 for Meta-Llama-3.1 (8B).

T1.justification: The dependency-count assumptions and argument in Section 4 and the RoPE scaling expression in Appendix B.1 are unchanged. No mathematical definitions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about the training recipe, short-context SFT, ProLong's 128K performance, 512K capability and long-context training efficiency.

C2.justification: Interpretations of data mixing, longer-sequence training and synthetic SFT are unchanged. The limitations concerning resources, model-scale generalization and possible benchmark overfitting are also identical.

D1.justification: Table 9 and Appendix A retain identical hyperparameters, hardware costs, implementation details, processing instructions and synthetic-data prompts. Code, data, model and detailed-results access links are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 7 and the reference list are identical. Neither citation membership nor the paper's positioning relative to earlier long-context training and evaluation research changes.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v2 dated 3 Apr 2025 to v3 dated 27 Jun 2025. All paper prose, headings and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The updated first-page arXiv margin stamp has a slightly different vertical position and extent. All figures, tables, captions and remaining page layouts are visually identical.

improvement.justification: The scientific text, empirical evidence, figures, tables and appendices are identical. Updating and slightly repositioning the arXiv stamp does not meaningfully improve or harm the paper's clarity, evidential support or reproducibility.
